name: 11kV HT Substation & AVR Regulation System
summary: 3600 kVA 11kV utility incomer feeding an 8-panel Ring Main Unit (RMU) switchboard integrated with a 3× 1-phase 11kV step AVR bank (±10% regulation) featuring dedicated maintenance bypass interlocks and dual outgoing feeders for Phase 1 and Phase 2 step-down transformers.
mermaid:
graph TD
    RMU([RMU]) --> |"Utility Power (11 kV)"| IM[["IM: Incomer Panel (1250A VCB)"]]
    IM --> comBUS([Common BUS])
    comBUS --- PT[[PT & Metering Cubicle]]
    comBUS --> avrIN[["AVR IN (1250A VCB)"]]
    comBUS --> avrBP[["AVR BP: Bypass Breaker (1250A VCB)"]]
    avrIN --> avr(3xSingle Phase 11 KV AVR)
    avr --> avrOUT[["AVR OUT (1250A VCB)"]]
    avrOUT --> distBUS([Distribution BUS])
    avrBP --> avrBPRU[[AVR Bypass Return Unit]]
    avrBPRU --> distBUS
    avrBP o.-o |"E/M InterLock"|avrOUT
    distBUS --> QM1[["QM Feeder 1 (1250A VCB)"]]
    distBUS --> QM2[["QM Feeder 2 (1250A VCB)"]]
    QM1 --> F1("Phase 1 Transformer Feeder(2000 kVA Cast Resin XFR)") --- A@{ shape: bolt, label: "Communication link" }
    QM2 --> F2("Phase 1 Transformer Feeder(1600 kVA Cast Resin XFR)") --- B@{ shape: bolt, label: "Communication link" }

stages.detail: 3600 kVA utility power enters via the 630A Incomer Panel (IM) equipped with an earthing switch, vacuum circuit breaker, and cable testing facilities.
Dedicated PT & Metering panel tapped off the primary busbar provides voltage transformation, surge suppression, and power quality metering.
Power flows via 'AVR IN' (630A) into 3 sets of single-phase 11kV step AVR units (AVR-1, AVR-2, AVR-3) stabilizing voltage within ±10% before feeding back through 'AVR OUT' (630A).
During AVR servicing, power is routed through 'AVR BP' and returned via 'AVR BP RU'. A key mechanical/electrical interlock ensures the bypass and AVR output cannot be tied out of sequence.
The regulated 11kV distribution bus feeds two 630A QM outgoing cubicles: Phase 1 (feeding the 2000 kVA dry transformer) and Phase 2 (feeding the 1600 kVA dry transformer).

name: Power Infrastructure System
summary: Dual-utility 33kV/11kV grid inputs, transformer step-down, synchronized generator bus, static transfer, and 2N UPS trains feeding server racks.
mermaid:
graph TD
    DG1(DG1) --> |Busway 3200A| 1DGSB[[1DGSB]] --> SPD3[\Class A+B SPD/]
    A@{ shape: bolt, label: \"Communication link\" } --> |Phase 1| TX1(((Transfromer 2000KVA)))
    DG2(DG2) --> |Busway 3200A| 2DGSB[[2DGSB]]
    B@{ shape: bolt, label: \"Communication link\" } --> |Phase 2| TX2(((Transfromer 1600KVA)))
    DG3(DG3) --> |Busway 3200A| 3DGSB[[3DGSB]]
    TX1 --> 1LTSB[["1LTSB (3200A ACB)"]] --> 1ATSA{"1ATS-A"} & 1PFI[(1200 kvar)] & SPD1[\Class A+B SPD/] & 1ATSB{"1ATS-B"}
    TX2 --> 2LTSB[["2LTSB (2500A ACB)"]] --> 21PFI[(960 kvar)] & 2ATSB{"2ATS-B"} & SPD2[\Class A+B SPD/] & 2ATSA{"2ATS-A"}
    1DGSB --> |Busway 3200A| 1ATSA --> |Busway 3200A| 1MDBA[[1MDB-A]]
    2DGSB --> |Busway 3200A| 1ATSB --> |Busway 3200A| 1MDBB[[1MDB-B]]
    3DGSB --> |Busway 3200A| 2ATSA --> |Busway 3200A| 2MDBA[[2MDB-A]]
    3DGSB --> SPD5[\Class A+B SPD/]
    2DGSB --> SPD4[\Class A+B SPD/]
    2DGSB --> |Busway 3200A| 2ATSB --> |Busway 3200A| 2MDBB[[2MDB-B]]
    1MDBA --> 1UPSA1[[1UPS-A1]] & 1UPSA2[[1UPS-A2]]
    1MDBB --> 1UPSB1[[1UPS-B1]] & 1UPSB2[[1UPS-B2]]
    1UPSA1 --- B1([LiFePO4])
    1UPSA2 --- B2([LiFePO4])
    1UPSB1 --- B3([LiFePO4])
    1UPSB2 --- B4([LiFePO4])
    1UPSA1 & 1UPSA2 --> 1ITudbA[[1IT-UDB-A]]
    1UPSB1 & 1UPSB2 --> 1ITudbB[[1IT-UDB-B]]
    1ITudbA & 1ITudbB --> C1{{Containment 1}}
    1ITudbA & 1ITudbB --> C2{{Containment 2}}

stages.detail: Redundant 33kV power feeds stepped to 11kV at the intake substation.
Dual-bus 11kV vacuum switchgear with protective relaying.
Cast-resin 2500kVA dry transformers reducing voltage to 415V/240V.
4x 2500kVA synchronized Cummins diesel gensets taking full load within 12 seconds.
Modular UPS trains running in 2N configuration guaranteeing clean sine wave.
Intelligent A+B busway and rack PDUs feeding redundant enterprise dual-cord power supplies.

name: HVAC & Precision Cooling System
summary: Water-cooled centrifugal chiller plant with plate heat exchanger economizer, secondary pumped chilled water loops, and In-Row PAC units with Cold-Aisle Containment.
mermaid:
graph TD
  Chiller[Water-Cooled Chiller 450TR] --> PrimPump[Primary Pump Loop]
  PrimPump --> SecPump[Secondary VFD Pumps]
  SecPump --> Ring[Dual-Ring Chilled Water Header]
  Ring --> PAC1[In-Row Cooler Pod 1]
  Ring --> PAC2[In-Row Cooler Pod 2]
  Ring --> PAC3[In-Row Cooler Pod 3]
  PAC1 --> ColdAisle[Cold Aisle Containment 22°C]
  ColdAisle --> Rack[Server Equipment]
  Rack --> HotAisle[Hot Aisle Return 35°C]
  HotAisle --> PAC1

stages.detail: Centrifugal chillers maintain 7°C supply with 13°C return loops.
VFD-controlled secondary pumps adjust flow based on aisle differential pressure.
In-Row precision air units blow cold air horizontally directly in front of IT intakes.
Physical roof and sliding doors isolate supply cold air from heated server exhaust air.

name: Fire Detection & Suppression System
summary: Multi-stage defense employing aspirating smoke detection (VESDA) for early warnings, cross-zoned smoke detectors, and FK-5-1-12 clean agent gaseous flooding.
mermaid:
graph TD
  VESDA[Aspirating Smoke Detector] --> Alert1[Level 1: NOC Pre-Alarm Alert]
  DetA[Smoke Detector Zone A] --> CrossCheck{Dual Zone Coincidence?}
  DetB[Smoke Detector Zone B] --> CrossCheck
  CrossCheck -- Yes --> Timer[30s Evacuation Countdown & Sirens]
  Timer --> Actuate[Release FK-5-1-12 Clean Agent Gas]
  Actuate --> RoomExtinguish[Total Flooding Extinguishment without water]
  CrossCheck -- No --> Alert2[Visual Annunciator Warning]

stages.detail: Continuous active air drawing via VESDA pipe network detects particles at incipient combustion.
Two independent optical/ionization detector loops must trigger to arm gas discharge.
30-second warning sirens sound while HVAC dampers automatically snap shut.
Clean agent discharges in under 10 seconds, eliminating oxygen-free combustion while remaining non-toxic to humans.
